spanish_winners_only._note: Owner Nov 23 ("Approve next steps"): until Vice Replay en Español has an audience, a Spanish version of an English Short is uploaded only if the English one did well in its first 24 h (views >= max(min_views_24h, median 24 h views of our last 7 days)).
